LESSON: THE TEN COMMANDMENTS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.2: The Ten Commandments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Ten Commandments. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should you obey the Ten Commandments?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments
2. appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE TEN COMMANDMENTS
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Ten Commandments helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE TEN COMMANDMENTS
Study The Ten Commandments like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments

What this means
In this part you learn to identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The Ten Commandments” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The Ten Commandments in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Ten Commandments is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The Ten Commandments” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The Ten Commandments in your own words. (skill: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Ten Commandments to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments.
4. Make one local Kenya example of The Ten Commandments from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Ten Commandments: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study The Ten Commandments?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you obey the Ten Commandments?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Ten Commandments means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments.
5. Be able to: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
